For \(t=\frac yz\), feasible values are \(t\in\mathbb R\setminus\{0,\frac32\}\).

On \(t<\frac32\), the denominator \(2t-3<0\), so
\[
f(t)=\frac{t^2}{2t-3}<0
\]
for all admissible \(t\neq 0\). Moreover, as \(t\to \frac32^-\),
\[
f(t)=\frac{t^2}{2t-3}\to -\infty.
\]
Thus the expression is unbounded below, so it has no minimum.

\[
\boxed{\text{No minimum exists}}
\]
